name: python-dev
description: Python development skills including best practices, FastAPI patterns, testing, type safety auditing, dbt integration, Dagster pipelines

hooks.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r ".tool_input.command"); if [[ "$cmd" =~ ^python ]]; then uv run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/python-uv-guard.py" >&2; exit 2; fi; if [[ "$cmd" =~ ^git\ add ]]; then echo "$input" | uv run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ruff-before-add.py"; fi'
